However, let's look at the specific phrasing. The patient says "feeling really hot and sweaty" and "shivering". Dengue often presents with severe joint/muscle pain ("breakbone fever") and bleeding tendencies (red spots). The patient mentions "skin is really itchy" but doesn't mention red spots/rash explicitly, though itchiness can be part of it.

So, the draft `[DIAGNOSIS]malaria[/DIAGNOSIS]` stands.
